description: We are a team interested in space and health
summary: The goal of our project is to demonstrate, through a simulation, the health status of astronauts during space missions. While on such missions, astronauts may encounter various health issues or require regular medical monitoring. This simulation includes data and features for both male and female astronauts, covering aspects such as heart rate, oxygen levels, nutritional and hydration requirements, exercise regimens, sleep patterns, radiation exposure, attention levels (including an attention test), an AI-powered psychological and cognitive state tracker, bone health, medical diagnostics, and a first-aid guide.
